blocks.text: Siloli Desert, Red Lagoon and Green Lagoon

provenance.wordAbsenceReason: No Word passage matches the entire current day 8 block while preserving its protected accommodation. Paragraph p0052 names Palacio de Sal, whereas the current RU itinerary specifies Luna Salada.

blocks.text:
Set off early, at about 06:30, and spend the first part of the day in the Siloli Desert. You will see the Stone Tree before visiting the Red Lagoon, where flamingos live and breed.

Continue to Sol de Mañana, a geothermal area where steam and hot gases rise from fumaroles and the surrounding terrain shows signs of volcanic activity. At Polques, you can bathe in the hot springs, a contrast with the cold air and dry desert landscape.

Next, visit the Dalí Desert with its unusual stone columns and the Green Lagoon at the foot of Licancabur Volcano. The return route takes you through the Valley of the Rocks, with its large volcanic formations near Alota, and San Cristóbal. The town was moved from its original site to make way for one of Bolivia’s largest mines.

Arrive in Uyuni at around 18:00 and stay overnight at Luna Salada.

blocks.text: Uyuni – La Paz – Copacabana – Sun Island

08:00 Transfer to the airport to take the flight to La Paz. Flight OB 305 departs at 09:25 and arrives at 10:25.

We will pick you up from the airport to begin our journey to Lake Titicaca, enjoying the landscape of the Altiplano. After a 2-hour journey, we reach the narrowest section of the lake: the Tiquina Strait, which we will cross on a rudimentary local ferry along with the local people. Arrival in the town of Copacabana at 11:00. We will embark on a motorboat to travel across Lake Titicaca to Sun Island. Enjoy lunch, followed by a visit to the Palace of the Inca, or Pikkokaina, built under the Inca emperor Tupac Yupanqui. These ruins are believed to be the spiritual entrance to the sacred island. After a short walk, we reach the town of Yumani on top of the hill, where we will visit the "Escalinata Del Inca" (Inca's Stairway) leading to the "Fuente de las 3 aguas" (Fountain of the 3 Basins). Tradition dictates that drinking from its water can grant eternal life. You will have time to take photographs of the lake and the stunning Cordillera Real of the Andes. We return to the boat to go back to Copacabana. Night at Hotel Rosario del Lago.
